query:
SELECT empresaSlug, COUNT(*) as total, 
  SUM(CASE WHEN pinAcesso IS NULL OR pinAcesso = 'NULL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as sem_pin,
  SUM(CASE WHEN pinAcesso IS NOT NULL AND pinAcesso != 'NULL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as com_pin
FROM colaboradores
GROUP BY empresaSlug
ORDER BY empresaSlug;
